description:
[EPIC] Lower protocol dispatch through the dispatch matrix, fixing fz-9i4.7.2 (a multi-target protocol DirectCall is unmaterializable when the receiver is a union).

PROBLEM. Protocol callbacks (Enumerable.reduce, ...) are bare FunctionIds with no body (source_publish.rs:185). A call lowers as an ordinary DirectCall; resolve_function_call (jobs/semantic.rs:1161) routes protocol callbacks to resolve_protocol_call (1224), which intersects the receiver type with each impl's module_impl_target_ty and emits ONE CallTargetSummary per overlapping impl. Concrete receiver -> 1 target -> materializes. Union receiver (e.g. list|range, produced when one generic Enum.* activation serves both list and range callers and the receiver is coarsened by convergence_collapse because Enum.* does not itself dispatch on it) -> multi-target -> materialize_direct_call_edge (artifact.rs:573) requires single_target() -> fatal 'unresolved multi-target direct callsite'.

DIRECTION. The dispatch matrix (src/dispatch_matrix/) is the project's one engine for ordered semantic dispatch -> decision tree; its own doc names protocol dispatch as an intended producer that was never wired. Protocols stay; they lower through the matrix like every other dispatch producer. A protocol callback becomes a REAL function whose dispatch IS a matrix over the impls: a concrete receiver monomorphizes (reachable_clause_ids prunes the type arms); a union receiver dispatches at runtime on the value's type. The call to the callback collapses to a single DirectCall to that dispatcher.

PROVEN. A hand-written typed-multi-clause dispatcher over a list|struct union compiles and runs in interp AND AOT, via the existing entry-dispatch pipeline. That is the exact target the synthesis generates.

APPROACH = IR-LEVEL (decided by evidence; source synthesis is blocked because builtin_from_name has no 'list'/'map' and a Region::Type arm over a struct type panics at runtime). Build the dispatch from the already-resolved inputs: ProtocolDispatch arms (refresh_protocol_dispatch, world.rs:1766) give target ModuleId + impl FunctionId per impl; module_impl_target_ty(target) gives the exact Ty. Synthesize the callback's EntryDispatch (matrix: type_region arm for built-in targets, struct-shape arm for struct targets) and LoweredBody (one forwarding tail-call clause per impl), then resolve the callback as an ordinary single-target function.

Children: .1 synthesize the dispatcher; .2 route callback calls to it; .3 re-enable fz-9i4.7.2 fixtures + matrix green; .4 retire the dead resolve_protocol_call path and add the residual any-receiver fallback. Separate: fz-kot (Enum.take/drop return [] even monomorphically) is independent and also needed for enum_take_drop_split to be correct. Re-verify file:line vs HEAD.
title: [EPIC] Protocol dispatch through the dispatch matrix
